pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with diffuse, feathered edges. High spatial density with variable area; smaller, more rounded patches near the limbs and larger, more elongated polygons on the mid-flank and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light-colored pathways forming a grid. Nodes exhibit mostly tri-radiate junctions. Pathway thickness is relatively consistent across the flank, maintaining a narrow but continuous separation between dark patches.
